mapper.select: select id, openid, nickname, avatar_url, identity, enroll_year, create_time, update_time from `user` where openid = #{openId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into `user` (openid, nickname, avatar_url, identity, enroll_year, create_time, update_time) values (#{openId}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{identity}, #{enrollYear}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update `user` set nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, identity = #{identity}, enroll_year = #{enrollYear}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
